title: Battery Replacement Warranties — Limited Warranty Terms: Claims, Exclusions and Proof of Purchase
content:
These terms form part of each Battery Replacement Warranty Crestline issues with a battery. They state, line by line, where a claim may be made, how the original purchase is proven, whether the warranty follows the battery to a new owner, whether a claim is tied to the vehicle the battery was sold for, what a free replacement is, and which causes of failure are not covered.

## 1. Terms common to every line

| Term | Crestline Standard 24-Month Battery | Crestline Plus 30-Month Battery | Crestline Gold 36-Month Battery | Crestline AGM 36-Month Battery | Crestline Platinum AGM 48-Month Battery | Crestline Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month Battery |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Where a claim may be made | any Crestline store | any Crestline store | any Crestline store | any Crestline store | any Crestline store | any Crestline store |
| Proof of the original purchase | the ticket on the customer's profile | the ticket on the customer's profile | the ticket on the customer's profile | the ticket on the customer's profile | the ticket on the customer's profile | the ticket on the customer's profile |
| Warranty follows the battery to a new owner | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Claim accepted only for the battery in the vehicle it was sold for | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Free replacement must be the same line and group | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Installation of a free replacement is free | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Free replacement keeps the original purchase date and warranty | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## 2. Causes of failure not covered

| Cause | Standard 24-Month | Plus 30-Month | Gold 36-Month | AGM 36-Month | Platinum AGM 48-Month | Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Physical damage | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered |
| Freezing from discharge | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | — | — | Not covered |
| Improper installation by others | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | — |
| Wrong application | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered |
| Abuse | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered |

A dash means the cause is not on that line's list of excluded causes.

## 3. Reading the terms

- **Is freezing from discharge excluded on an AGM line?** No. Neither the Crestline AGM 36-Month Battery nor the Crestline Platinum AGM 48-Month Battery lists it; the four other lines do.
- **Is improper installation by others excluded on the Crestline Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month Battery?** No. It is the one line that does not list it.
- **Does a Crestline Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month Battery claim have to be made for the vehicle the battery was sold for?** No. It is the one line on which a claim is not limited to the battery in the vehicle it was sold for; on the five other lines the claim is accepted only for that battery in that vehicle.
- **When the vehicle is sold, does the warranty pass to the buyer?** No line's warranty follows the battery to a new owner.
- **After a free replacement, does the warranty start again?** No. On every line the replacement keeps the original purchase date and warranty.
